cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our invisible dinner guest is here. Introduce Mum while I finish the gravy, love.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't see where to look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stand beside the guest. Look towards me when you introduce her.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Hello, chair, this is Mum. She needs your seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch Mum another chair. Introduce her to our guest, love.

reason: Make the orientation offer explicit and have A take the seating burden after B names it; remove the closing lesson about invisibility and standing.
